name: Seneschal
ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn a living good player.
flavor: Of course I snoop through the guests' stuff! How else is the head of the house going to know what's going on?
firstNightReminder: The Seneschal might nod their head. If they do, point to a player.
otherNightReminder: The Seneschal might nod their head. If they do, point to a player.

name: Armorer
ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn 2 players that aren't the Demon.
flavor: A good suit of armor tells everyone who is inside. If you're a hero, it should be polished and clean. If you're a villain, it should be dark and spiky. Fashion doesn't lie!
firstNightReminder: The Armorer might nod their head. If they do, point to 2 players.
otherNightReminder: The Armorer might nod their head. If they do, point to 2 players.

name: Bookbinder
ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn how many living outsiders there are.
flavor: When you make books, you get to know all of the people who only leave their house to buy more books.
firstNightReminder: The Bookbinder might nod their head. Show them a number.
otherNightReminder: The Bookbinder might nod their head. Show them a number.

name: Private Eye
ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn the number of steps to the closest living Minion.
firstNightReminder: The Private Eye might nod their head. If they do, show them a number,

name: Jikininki
ability: If you were the last player to nominate today, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk, even if you are dead.
flavor: I used to wear a stupid ascot until a sandwich man complimented me.
otherNightReminder: If the Jikininki was the last player to nominate today, all Townsfolk are poisoned. :reminder:
